usages.explain: 何をしますか（なにをしますか）is used to ask "What will you do?"

examples.transcription: にちようびなにをしますか。
examples.mean: What will you do on Sunday?

examples.transcription: ゆうべなにをしましたか。
examples.mean: What did you do in the evening?

usages.explain: Note: You can add 「は」after the time noun to clarify the topic of the sentence.

title: 何をしますか => What are you doing...
